'''Bant Eerin's Padawan '''was a [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]]. He served the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]] and the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] as a [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

In a [[The galaxy/Legends|galaxy]] of ever-changing possibilities, the fate of this young [[Padawan/Legends|Padawan]] rested directly on his choices, ranging from becoming the hero of the [[Battle of Akoshissss]] to dying an ignominious [[Death/Legends|death]] at the hands of a [[Bounty hunter/Legends|bounty hunter]] or becoming a [[Slavery/Legends|slave]] in the [[Spice mines of Kessel/Legends|Spice Mines of Kessel]].

==Biography==
A [[Force-sensitive/Legends|Force-sensitive]] [[Human/Legends|Human]], he was [[Jedi training/Legends|educated]] in the ways of [[The Force/Legends|the Force]] at the [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order's]] [[Jedi Temple/Legends|Temple]] [[Jedi academy|academy]] at [[Coruscant/Legends|Coruscant]]. As an [[Jedi Initiate/Legends|Initiate]] at the academy, he befriended a young [[Iridonian (species)|Iridonian]] [[Zabrak/Legends|Zabrak]] named [[Jaylen Kos]], as well as Initiate [[Ahsoka Tano/Legends|Ahsoka Tano]]. Wielding a [[Color/Legends|green-bladed]] [[Lightsaber/Legends|Lightsaber]], he remained at the Temple when the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]] erupted between the Republic and the [[Confederacy of Independent Systems/Legends|Confederacy of Independent Systems]].<ref name="WOTJ" />

As the war taxed the numbers of the Jedi Order, the [[Jedi High Council/Legends|Jedi High Council]] decided to speed up the rate at which apprentices were being trained. Approached by [[Grand Master/Legends|Grand Master]] [[Yoda/Legends|Yoda]], the Human Initiate was dispatched to the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Kashyyyk/Legends|Kashyyyk]] where he would find his new [[Jedi/Legends|Jedi]] Master awaiting him. After meeting Master [[Bant Eerin/Legends|Bant Eerin]], the newly christened [[Jedi Commander/Legends|Commander]] took up his rank in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] and led [[Clone trooper/Legends|clone troopers]] to infiltrate the compound of [[Bitt Panith]] during the [[Battle of Akoshissss|battle]] on [[Akoshissss]]. The Padawan was initially unaware of his being followed by Initiate Kos and an [[Astromech droid/Legends|astromech droid]], [[R3-G0]], who would later come into the Jedi's possession. Jaylen Kos, R3-G0, and a clone trooper named [[Lex (clone trooper)|Lex]] were dispatched to deal with Panith's genetically engineered cyborg [[Krossen]] during the operation.<ref name="WOTJ" />

==Weapons==
The unidentified Padawan wields a green lightsaber.

==Behind the scenes==
This unidentified Padawan only appeared in ''[[The Clone Wars: Decide Your Destiny: The Way of the Jedi]]'', a book styled after the pattern of the ''Choose Your Own Adventures'' series of books. The character is intended to represent the reader who, after a brief introductory story, must begin making decisions in order to advance the story, turning to different pages based on the choices made. In all, there were 26 possible fates that could be met by this Padawan, some resulting in his being a hero, some resulting in grave consequences for the future of him and those around him, and some that ultimately seemed neither good nor bad on face, but were merely the result of a troubling conflict such as the Clone Wars. The story described in the above biography is merely one numerous possible fates for this character.
